description: Implementation of QuicSocketAddress class for handling socket addresses in QUIC protocol, including constructors, comparison operators, string conversion, and hashing functions.

classes.name: QuicSocketAddress
classes.description: Represents a network socket address with methods for construction, comparison, string conversion, and hashing.

methods.name: HashIP
methods.description: Computes a hash value for a given IP address, supporting both IPv4 and IPv6.

methods.name: QuicSocketAddress
methods.description: Constructs a socket address from an IP address and port.

methods.description: Constructs a socket address from a sockaddr_storage structure.

methods.name: QuicSocketAddress
methods.description: Constructs a socket address from a sockaddr pointer and length.

methods.description: Checks inequality of two QuicSocketAddress objects.
